allocation.admissible_whole_group: Current remaining row target exactly reachable after removal, enough rows for all future targets, every future target and their aggregate separately reachable by group-size bitset subset sum
allocation.arc_strata: Question stem whitespace-word count bins <=15, <=30, <=60, >60 crossed with original choice count; mixed-stratum groups have one explicit mixed stratum
allocation.cross_domain_components: Leave unused; never split a component between domains
allocation.failure: Fail explicitly if the deterministic sequential allocation cannot fill exact targets; no silent shrinking/refilling and no claim of global multi-split impossibility
allocation.fixed_proportions: Record counts per stratum in the original eligible single-domain population, fixed before split allocation
allocation.math_strata: Official source-file subject and native Level 1-5; the single diagnostic-bound Level ? remains unchanged and uses explicit metadata stratum unknown:Level ?; mixed-stratum groups have one explicit mixed stratum
allocation.next_group: Largest integer proportional row deficit; tie by lexical stratum then the declared SHA256 ordering
allocation.unit: whole connected question group; target counts are records, not groups

near_duplicate.short_question_policy: exact normalized equality when fewer than3tokens

operational_repair.reason: One official MATH source row has level Level ? rather than a numeric difficulty. Preserve it and assign a separate metadata stratum; no record or target alteration.

serialization.tokenization: Not performed in this CPU stage; exact native Qwen token/prompt/config validation remains mandatory before GPU generation

training_exclusion.future_rule: All future training, probe and source scoring from this pool must exclude these IDs and every reserved source question/group; new external sources need the same matching audit
training_exclusion.scope: All three reserved evaluation splits; MATH questions and ARC question stem plus rendered original choices
training_exclusion.source: Canonical prepared source pool only, every question checked against the declared exact lexical index
